events.verdict: Grimes (PHI) momentarily rests an arm across Carrington's (WAS) back while reaching for the ball.
Grimes (PHI) makes foot to foot contact with Carrington (WAS), which causes him to lose control of the ball.
Grimes (PHI) and Sarr (WAS) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the body contact between the two is incidental.
Grimes (PHI) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Carrington (WAS) as he reaches for the ball.
Bona (PHI) briefly has an arm around Sarr (WAS) before removing it as the pass is thrown.
Grimes (PHI) cleanly blocks Carrington's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Grimes' (PHI) momentum carries him into Middleton (WAS) as he secures the loose ball, but the contact is marginal.
The game is stopped due to a shot clock malfunction. Although Washington retains possession, the shot clock should have been reset to 1.3 seconds remaining instead of 0.7 seconds remaining.
George (WAS) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending on Bona (PHI) is overturned. Bona blocks the shot attempt before it contacts the backboard with a chance to score. Since the ball was loose and neither team had imminent possession, play resumes with a jump ball.
Grimes (PHI) legally contests Middleton's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Edgecombe (PHI) initiates contact with George (WAS) that affects his FOM.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Sarr's (WAS) shot attempt makes contact with the rim and therefore, the shot clock is reset to 14 and WAS retains possession.
Middleton (WAS) is late to establish a screening position and he delivers contact to Grimes (PHI).

George (WAS) places his off-arm against Bona (PHI) as the two players come together in mid-air following the release of George's driving shot attempt. The ensuing contact between the two players is marginal.
Sarr (WAS) commits a take foul on Oubre Jr. (PHI).
Carrington (WAS) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Bona (PHI) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Carrington (WAS) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
McCollum (WAS) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
George (WAS) commits a take foul on Grimes (PHI).
